items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib/chest injury from big hit in Week 1; left early after 5/82/1.
items.implication: Week 2 status up in air; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for other LAC WRs if out

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week's meniscus trim; optimistic for potential Week 2 return.
items.why: Meniscus cleanup; working hard to return.
items.implication: Possible active Week 2 vs LAC; Mayer filled in with 6 catches.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending. Coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Left early after 5/150/1; sources say not serious.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 but monitor; backup plans needed.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring), Dylan Sampson (knee), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist), Omar Cooper (ankle).
items.why: Left early or notable injuries from Sunday slate.
items.implication: Key monitors for Week 2; Lane longer-term (wrist).
items.opportunity: Bateman/others if Flowers out; LAC depth if McConkey out

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2.
items.why: As expected for good offense; hyper-focused touches.
items.implication: Lock in the big 4; fade others in DET.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7 targets all caught, 1 rush TD); but sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Great matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: Goal-line work and route edge over Gainwell; healthy.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside; handcuff less needed if healthy.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but two almost-plays; 92% route participation. Want all the Loveland, buying low where possible.
items.why: Elite route share despite quiet stats; near-misses.
items.implication: Buy-low TE target; volume there for breakout.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps Etienne 53/Miller 26/Donaldson 15; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4. Committee not full takeover.
items.why: Even without Kamara, shared with Miller/Donaldson.
items.implication: Etienne not automatic RB1; monitor if Kamara returns.
items.opportunity: Miller/Donaldson handcuff value if Etienne limited
items.conflict: Expected full dominate vs actual split
corroboration: ETR: Kamara not expected affects Etienne proj

items.text: Malik Nabers officially active after late decision (family didn't come due to uncertainty); start him with decoy risk but still start everywhere.
items.why: Late call ~2 hours before kickoff; knee issue.
items.implication: Start with risk of limited/decoy snaps; post-active usage positive per notes.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out due to wrist injury; longer absence expected (fractured).
items.implication: Miss several weeks; opens WR snaps in BAL.

items.text: Weekend reports: EXPECTED TO PLAY Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Rome Odunze (calf); NOT EXPECTED Alvin Kamara (knee); NO NEWS YET Malik Nabers (knee, later active). Kamara status impacts Etienne proj.
items.implication: Start Love/Odunze; fade Kamara, adjust Etienne down; Nabers resolved active.
items.opportunity: Etienne volume if Kamara out (partially realized)

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even with Dylan Sampson (knee) out early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Limited receiving upside; more pure runner.

items.text: Week 1 concerns: Loveland (despite routes), LAC offense, Fannin, London & Pitts, Etienne. Time now for Watson, Likely, Monty & Coke Heads.
items.why: Post-Week 1 film/box reactions on Happy Hour.
items.implication: Buy Monty/Watson/Likely; caution on listed concerns.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season is well underway.
items.why: Strong Week 1 performance signaling larger role.
items.opportunity: Role expansion in BAL passing game
corroboration: FF Happy Hour: time for Likely
